segments.t: Defaults for the dual-panel KTPH001SFTP file managerKTPH002 and for the JobScheduler's Rsync jobs. Open via KTPH003Configuration → Global Settings → SFTP ManagerKTPH004; stored in KTPH000.

An idle SFTP tab closes itself after the timeout, which frees the server-side connection when you forget to close the manager. The timeout field is only editable while the toggle is on, and the two share one stored value: switching the toggle off stores no timeout at all.
These are the defaults for creating a ZIP archive KTPH000on the remote serverKTPH001 from the SFTP manager.
KTPH000 means no compression (fastest) and KTPH001 the best compression (slowest).

Leave the path empty to use the KTPH000 found on KTPH001. KTPH004BrowseKTPH005 picks a binary explicitly. Rsync jobs additionally require KTPH002 to be available on KTPH003; see KTPH006JobSchedulerKTPH007.
